title: SciHorizon: Benchmarking AI-for-Science Readiness from Scientific Data to Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLMs using generated scenario-based multiple-choice questions set in scientific research contexts to test their adherence to fairness and justice principles.
Assessing scientific datasets for coverage and representativeness across different parameters (e.g., temporal and spatial distributions) to ensure balanced or natural distributions.
